answer.answer: Yes. The updated Fern CI FAQ now specifies that Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days [fern-faq-new]. Previously, the FAQ stated that the retention period was not specified [fern-faq-old]; that earlier statement remains historically valid but has been superseded by the new 30-day figure.
change_events: The Fern CI FAQ was updated to state that Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days, replacing the earlier statement that the retention period was not specified [fern-faq-old, fern-faq-new].
current_truths: Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days [fern-faq-new].
historical_truths: An earlier version of the Fern CI FAQ stated that the build-log retention period was not specified [fern-faq-old].
